::: {#rem-choosing-method}
#### Which method to try

- Try a direct proof (@def-direct-proof) first.
- Try the contrapositive (@def-proof-by-contrapositive) when $\neg Q$ is the easier assumption (@rem-contrapositive-template).
- Try contradiction (@def-proof-by-contradiction) when the proposition says that something does not exist or is not true,
  as in "no integers satisfy", "is irrational" or "infinitely many":
  its negation hands you an object to work with.

:::
